blocked.title: The Code tab isn't unlocked yet
blocked.description: The Architect hasn't decided which container image to use for this project yet. Without that decision the container doesn't start, and it's the container that isolates execution — there's nowhere to run the code this tab would show.
blocked.note: As soon as the Architect issues the image decision, this tab unlocks on its own — no need to reload the page manually.

bottomPanel.problemsEmpty: There's no integrated lint or tests running over this project's code — no static analysis tool scans the managed repository today. Showing an error or warning count here would be decoration, not state: once that integration exists, this tab will start listing real diagnostics.
bottomPanel.outputEmpty: There's no AGGREGATED build or deploy command stream in this tab — the interactive terminal (Terminal tab) already has its own output, inside it. `git push`, PR and deploy don't go through the terminal anyway (RN-106): once there's a build or deploy pipeline separate from the terminal, its output will show up here.
